summary: Private deployment: audit log exporter falling behind; missing events in customer SIEM
description:
Deployment mode: Private (on-prem).

Issue summary:
Customer reports gaps in their SIEM ingestion from Redwood audit logs. Their compliance team flagged missing RBAC admin actions in the last 24 hours. Private deployment includes audit-log-exporter shipping to customer-managed Splunk HEC.

Impact:
- Audit trail incomplete in customer SIEM (compliance risk)
- Product functionality largely unaffected, but security/compliance impact is high

Investigation notes:
- Exporter pod CPU pegged; queue depth growing
- Splunk HEC returns intermittent 503 and exporter retries with no backpressure cap
- Exporter logs show repeated re-serialization and high memory usage

Customer request:
Need confirmation of which events were missed and a durable fix to prevent gaps.
comments: 2026-02-25 10:22 UTC (Avery Johnson): Opened P1 due to compliance impact. Requesting timestamps and HEC error samples from customer.
2026-02-25 11:05 UTC (Customer - AurumBank): Provided Splunk HEC logs showing bursts of 503 and ingestion throttling.
2026-02-25 12:10 UTC (Olga Petrov): Found exporter uses unbounded retry with high CPU JSON encoding; falls behind and drops when pod OOM-killed.
2026-02-25 12:40 UTC (Olga Petrov): Mitigation: scale exporter replicas to 3 and set max_batch_bytes lower; queue depth stabilizing.
2026-02-26 09:30 UTC (Olga Petrov): PR 128 adds bounded retry with disk-backed spool + explicit backpressure metrics.
2026-02-26 16:55 UTC (Avery Johnson): Shared list of impacted window based on control-plane stored audit logs; customer re-ingested from export replay.
2026-02-27 08:20 UTC (Olga Petrov): Hotfix deployed to customer on-prem. Queue depth normal; no gaps for 12h.
resolution: Scaled audit log exporter and deployed hotfix implementing bounded retry plus spool/backpressure metrics. Customer replayed audit logs for the impacted window into SIEM.
workaround: If Splunk HEC is unstable: temporarily increase exporter replicas and reduce batch size; enable replay from stored audit log retention to backfill gaps.
root_cause: Exporter had unbounded retry and CPU-heavy encoding, leading to backlog growth and OOM kills during downstream SIEM ingestion errors, causing audit event gaps.
follow_ups: Add alert on exporter queue depth and drop rate
Document SIEM outage playbook + replay procedure
Add load test for sustained 503/throttle from downstream
